launches.title: Linc: The discovery layer for enterprise AI
launches.tagline: Linc is an AI-native process intelligence platform that captures workflows and unwritten business rules, identifies where AI can create value, and provides the context to redesign processes and build agents.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Linc turns workflow recordings, AI interviews, and existing operational knowledge into SOPs, process maps, and prioritized improvements. That knowledge becomes a shared memory your team can query and build on for future transformation projects. We're live in 20+ enterprises.\
\
Learn more at: <https://withlinc.com>

Launch Video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S6BSzghhNE4>

**Why we built this**

We started by deploying AI agents for enterprises and spent more time scoping them than building them. Much of what we needed was tribal knowledge: people knew which rules applied to a particular customer or vendor, but those rules had never been written down.

We’d miss those details during scoping and only uncover them when implementation got stuck. We built Linc to capture that knowledge during discovery and keep building on it.

**What Linc does**

* **Scout** combines workflow recordings with AI interviews to capture steps, decisions, business rules, and handoffs.
* Linc generates draft SOPs and process maps in minutes, including the exceptions captured during discovery.
* **Architect** uses that evidence to rank opportunities for AI, automation, and process improvement.

Teams can also bring in existing process documents, meeting transcripts, and system logs to add context to what employees record and explain.

For example, a recording might show someone routing a case to a manager. The interview can uncover the approval rule behind that decision. Linc brings both into the process documentation.

**A shared memory for future projects**

We think of Linc as a system of record for process transformation: a shared memory of your organization’s workflows, business rules, and decisions.

Your team can ask questions about a process, add new context, and create training materials, change management plans, or roadmaps for leadership. That context also helps ground AI agents in your company’s workflows and rules.

As your team captures more work and adds what it learns, the knowledge compounds. Each new project builds on what you’ve already captured.

Employees control their recordings. No system integrations are needed to start capturing. Linc is SOC 2 Type II audited and HIPAA compliant.

We’re working with Fortune 500 companies in utilities, pharma, and supply chain.

**Our asks**

1. **Enterprise introductions.** We’d appreciate intros to transformation, operational excellence, and operations leaders who are prioritizing AI initiatives or preparing a manual process for automation.
2. **Agent-company partnerships.** We already work with organizations through white-label and direct partnerships. That can include integrating Linc with their solution or exporting outputs in formats their teams and platforms can use. If you’re scoping an active deal or customer project, especially with forward-deployed engineers working directly with customers, we’d love to show you how Linc can help with discovery and requirements.
3. **PE introductions.** We’d appreciate intros to operating partners and value creation teams helping portfolio companies improve operational efficiency and accelerate AI transformation.

Reach out at [founders@linc-ai.com](mailto:founders@linc-ai.com).
